about: Non-chest checks for the randomizer (v1): gifts = event-flow string parameters to rewrite (every first-time branch, .110 twins included); loose = world item actors to swap (every map file holding the Hash). Built from research/mapping/gifts_*.json and verified against the romfs; see research/gifts_review.txt.

checks.notes: The game loads the .110 twin (identical events). The Heart Piece is a lottery outcome of the tour (not guaranteed on the first dig). Events 179 (DropActorName) and 224 (EventMiniGameDiggingHoleAdventActor) are the dug-up model: left alone they show a Heart Piece, the give is 602. checks.rule_evidence: Npc_Goron_006_Child 4 ?IsExistInPouch Item_BombBag_Medium {owned:10, no:3}, 3 ?IsExistInPouch Item_BombBag_Small {owned:11, no:12 talk only}: the gift needs a bomb bag; SoH's HasExplosives also allows bombchus and its rolling-strength trick. (The port's CanUse(RG_BOMB_BAG) includes the remake's Goron's Bracelet requirement for bombs.) HookshotRando: HasItem, not CanUse: the Goron only looks for a bag in the pouch; CanUse(RG_BOMB_BAG) also asks for the Goron's Bracelet (the remake's bomb-pull rule).
checks.name: Rolling Goron (child)
checks.notes: Precondition: owning a bomb bag (4 ?IsExistInPouch BombBag_Medium / 3 ?BombBag_Small, then 10/11 ?IsGet.Item_BombBag_Small); with none the Goron only talks (12) and gives nothing. Owning a Medium bag without ever getting the Small one also gives nothing (10). Gives through the flow's own NpcCommon_HandOver_NpcToPlayer_NoDisplay_BombBag -> Dm_SY_GetInEvent:GetInEvent_NotTurn_BombBag (bomb-bag get animation; ActorName from the argument): this variant is untested. Flag GoronCity_GetBombBag_fromGoron006.
